The '''Bylluran system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byllura]] was located in the system, and during the [[Republic Dark Age]], it served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the [[Dyarchy]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state that was led by the child [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Dromika]] and [[Quillan (Sith)|Sith]]. In c. [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], forces of the [[Arkadianate]] Sith state [[Battle of Byllura|clashed]] with the [[Dyarchy Fleet]] over Byllura, and control of the planet fell to the Arkadianites.

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], originally placed the system in grid square M-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
